title: Preparation of ASW+NO3 Medium
author: Roscoff Culture Collection
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s5zeg76

steps.title: Dissolve each component separately
steps.instruction: Dissolve 25 g NaCl (and any other listed components) in MilliQ water, preparing each component in a separate container.

steps.title: Combine component solutions
steps.instruction: After each component is fully dissolved, combine all solutions into a single vessel.

steps.title: Adjust pH to 8
steps.instruction: Adjust the pH of the combined solution to 8 using concentrated HCl.

steps.title: Set volume to 999 mL
steps.instruction: Bring the solution volume to 999 mL with MilliQ water.

steps.title: Add trace metals
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of trace‑metal solution (see recipe below) to the medium.

steps.title: Adjust final volume to 1 L
steps.instruction: After cooling, adjust the final volume to 1 L with MilliQ water.

steps.title: Store medium refrigerated
steps.instruction: Store the prepared ASW+NO₃ medium in a refrigerator.
